town.text: Of course you may. Everything has a price. Shall we discuss yours?
town.direction: smooth, amused, elven lilt; never raises her voice

town.text: Emberwick is so charming in the cold. Everyone becomes so reasonable.
Do come up to the house. The lamps are lovely this time of year. Every time of year, really.
My family has been generous to this town for a century. The town does keep forgetting.
Grain, coin and patience. I have a great deal of all three. Most people have none.
The mayor owes me rather a lot. He's sweet about it. Debtors usually are.
The old days? Don't ask me, darling. I find them dreadfully dull.
Such a mess on the bridge. Still, the road is open, and roads are so very good for business.
Feeding goblins from the town's stores. How generous. I do hope someone is keeping accounts.
